source.title: Solutions to open problems on the exponential augmented Zagreb index

trace.notes: Treated https://zbmath.org/8171158 as a zbMATH bibliographic resolver. Local resolver metadata and DBLP identified the exact work as 'Solutions to open problems on the exponential augmented Zagreb index', Discrete Mathematics 349(6): 114967 (2026), DOI 10.1016/j.disc.2025.114967, PII S0012365X25005758.

Failure mode: paywalled_or_restricted plus metadata_only. The local shell could not resolve zbmath.org for direct fetching. Browser/web recovery found the ScienceDirect DOI landing/abstract page, DBLP metadata, and exact-title search results, but no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the technical problem statements. Search candidates were rejected because they were abstract/citation metadata, unpaywall/DBLP resolver links without a confirmed readable artifact, ResearchGate request-only pages, or a different 2024 Applied Mathematics and Computation work with a similar title.
Input could not be normalized to a readable PDF or HTML full-text source within the bounded recovery pass, so no questions were extracted from metadata, abstracts, search snippets, or related papers.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/8171158.json and outputs/latest.json.
